Specifically, Jasminoside T is linked to Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, which in turn is targeted by Wikstroelide E and alpha-Fenchyl acetate. Both Wikstroelide E and alpha-Fenchyl acetate are known to target Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, indicating a chain of interactions that may lead to the modulation of this transporter. The scores from the different paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with varying degrees of support from each pathway. The integration of these findings implies that Jasminoside T may influence the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 through a series of intermediate targets, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The evidence is consistent across different pathways, suggesting a plausible biological link, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Jasminoside T and the transporter.
